name: Pica AI
description_en:
Pica AI presents face swapping, photo restoration and professional-headshot generation. Its homepage says the photo enhancer moved to Artguru on October 31, 2025; that link now redirects to Artguru, so it should not be described as an unchanged Pica workflow.

The still-readable Pica pages describe photo/video face swaps and headshots from multiple selfies. These tasks need identity and likeness review, not just a visual-quality check. No actual upload or output was tested.
description_zh:
Pica AI 展示换脸、照片恢复和职业头像。首页称增强器于 2025-10-31 升级到 Artguru，该链接现跳转 Artguru，不能当未变化 Pica 流程。

仍可读 Pica 页介绍照片/视频换脸及多自拍头像，这些任务需身份和肖像核查，不只看画质，本文未上传或生成。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload a source and target faces; documented maximum three faces.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传原素材和目标脸，文档最多 3 脸。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose styles and upload six to twelve clear photos.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选风格并上传 6–12 张清晰照片。

en: Prepare a personally authorized profile headshot and check identity details.
zh: 准备本人授权头像并核身份细节。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm the active Pica route and rights, use authorized source photos and inspect the downloaded result.
steps.zh: 确认有效 Pica 路径及权利，使用授权原照并检查下载结果。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Feature/in-service purchase and potential recurring plan; current amount unknown.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Actual amounts unavailable. Terms describe recurring in-service purchases and channel-specific refund handling; free labels do not establish allowances. Headshot package amount and output terms need confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 实际金额不可得；条款有自动续费及按渠道退款，免费标签不证明额度。头像金额及输出条款需确认。

sources.title: Pica AI

sources.title: Pica AI pricing

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Test identity fidelity before professional use
sections.title_zh: 职业使用前核身份保真
sections.en: For an illustrative profile update, use your own authorized photos and compare the generated face, hairline, glasses and proportions with reality. Do not imply a fabricated role, endorsement or event. Headshots are described as taking forty minutes to two hours, but processing time and HD-to-3K output were not independently measured.
sections.zh: 例如个人资料更新，使用本人授权照，核生成脸、发际、眼镜及比例，不暗示虚假职位、代言或事件。头像称需 40 分钟至 2 小时，处理时间及 HD–3K 未独立测。

sections.title_en: Keep migration and active Pica tools distinct
sections.title_zh: 区分迁移与仍在 Pica 的工具
sections.en: The enhancer route redirects to an Artguru URL with a Pica parameter, whereas face-swap and headshot documentation remain on Pica. This establishes a route change, not all-account migration or shared billing. Face swapping documents up to three replacements and GIF/MP4 video downloads. Test a short authorized clip for occlusion and identity continuity before relying on it.
sections.zh: 增强路径跳 Artguru 且带 Pica 参数，换脸/头像文档仍在 Pica，只证明路径变化，不证明所有账户迁移或共享计费。换脸最多 3 个，视频称可 GIF/MP4 下载，需用授权短片核遮挡及身份连续。

sections.title_zh: 澄清保留与输出权利表述
sections.en: Feature FAQs say uploads are deleted after twenty-four hours and headshots have full commercial rights. General terms give a revocable content license for operating/improving the service and say deletion ends future training use without affecting prior training. They also describe a personal noncommercial service-access license. These statements concern different scopes; obtain the applicable output and processing terms rather than assume a no-training promise.
sections.zh: 功能 FAQ 称上传 24 小时删除、头像完整商用权。通用条款授予运营/改进可撤销内容许可，删除仅终止未来训练、不影响既往，又把服务访问许可描述为个人非商用。范围不同，需确认适用输出/处理条款，不能推不训练。

sections.title_en: Read the actual checkout instead of importing old prices
sections.title_zh: 读真实结算而非沿用旧价格
sections.en: No package amount was readable on the headshot page. Terms describe recurring weekly/monthly/annual purchases and separate app-store versus web refund channels. A free face-swap label does not establish unlimited or sustained free use. No purchase, refund, file export or data deletion was tested; do not infer prices, model licenses or a self-hosted product.
sections.zh: 头像页无可读金额，条款介绍周/月/年自动续费及商店/网页不同退款渠道。免费换脸标签不证明无限或持续免费。本文未测购买、退款、文件导出或删除，不推价格、模型许可或自托管。

research_gaps: Enhancer migrated to Artguru; account/billing migration not established.
No prices, generation, claimed twenty-four-hour deletion, training treatment, refund, output license, source license or self-hosting independently verified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
